takes.prompt: A steady diesel engine of a tracked armored vehicle running at medium RPM under gentle load. Close mechanical recording: deep pulsing low-frequency motor rumble with restrained midrange engine vibration. Constant speed throughout, seamless continuous loop, no start or stop, no acceleration, no track clatter, no voices, no music, no battle ambience. Dry isolated game sound effect.

slots.acceptance: Stable pitch and load; no startup, gearshift or obvious loop seam. Leave room for cannon transients.

takes.prompt: Steel caterpillar tracks of a heavy armored vehicle rolling steadily over compact dirt at a moderate constant speed. Close dry mechanical sound: rhythmic low rolling rumble and evenly repeated metal tread clacks, restrained grit. Seamless continuous loop, constant pace, no start or stop, no engine, no squealing, no large impacts, no voices, no music, no battle ambience. Isolated game sound effect.

slots.acceptance: Rhythmic continuous track bed without a prominent bump at each loop; no engine duplication.

takes.prompt: One single 45 mm tank cannon firing, heard close beside the gun outdoors. Immediate sharp compact muzzle crack, short punchy low-frequency thump, brief mechanical recoil clack and a fast natural decay. Exactly one shot, onset at the beginning, no long echo, no shell impact, no reload sequence, no voices, no music, no ambience. Dry isolated game sound effect.

slots.acceptance: One prompt attack; short decay; clearly lighter than the medium cannon. Trim lead-in before runtime use.
